name: devops-consumption
description: A pane tracking GitLab compute minutes, storage and seats, and Azure DevOps pipeline minutes, parallel jobs and licenses

gitlabNamespaces.title: GitLab namespaces
gitlabNamespaces.description: Comma-separated top-level namespaces to track; empty tracks every one glab can see

gitlabMinutesQuota.title: GitLab monthly compute minutes quota
gitlabMinutesQuota.description: Overrides the plan default (free 400, premium 10000, ultimate 50000); 0 uses the plan default

adoOrg.title: Azure DevOps organization
adoOrg.description: The organization name in dev.azure.com/<org>; empty turns ADO tracking off

adoPatSecret.title: Azure DevOps PAT in Key Vault
adoPatSecret.description: vault/secret holding the PAT, read with az keyvault secret show (e.g. my-vault/ado-pat, cached an hour); used before the PAT field and az

adoPat.title: Azure DevOps personal access token
adoPat.description: A PAT with Build (read), Member Entitlement Management (read) and Agent Pools (read); used instead of az when set

adoTenant.title: Azure DevOps tenant
adoTenant.description: Entra tenant ID backing the ADO org, passed to az account get-access-token; empty reads it from the org

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane refetches usage, at least 5

warnPercent.title: Warn at percent of quota
warnPercent.description: A meter turns amber and toasts once a month when it reaches this percent
